title: Eventual overlap compatibility for fixed local module models
statement: Let $I$ be a directed preorder, $R:I\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ a functor with Noetherian rings $R_k$, and $c$ a limit cone of $R^{\mathrm{op}}\circ\operatorname{Spec}$ with affine vertex $S$. Fix $i\in I$ and a quasi-compact, quasi-separated, locally finitely presented morphism $f:X_i\to\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)$ [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions]. Put $X=X_i\times_{\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)}S$ and $X_j=X_i\times_{\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)}\operatorname{Spec}(R_j)$ for $j\geq i$ [def-pc-base-change]. Fix $j\geq i$ and a finite affine open cover $U_a\to X_j$. Suppose finitely presented quasi-coherent modules $N_a$ on $U_a$ [pqf-def-coherent] and a module $M$ on $X$ are given, together with component isomorphisms from the pullbacks of $N_a$ to the restrictions of $M$ on the pulled-back cover. Then there is $k\geq j$ such that the cover $V=U\times_{X_j}X_k$ carries descent data $D$. Each $D_a$ is isomorphic to the pullback of the prescribed $N_a$ to $V_a$. Moreover there is a morphism $\eta$ from the pullback of $D$ to the restriction descent datum of $M$ on the pulled-back $V$, and every component of $\eta$ is invertible. No global module is constructed, no local objects are descended, and no finite-presentation or quasi-coherence conclusion about $D_a$ is asserted. The supplied isomorphisms need not be compatible initially; their conjugates prescribe the overlap identifications to be lifted.

proof.text: Conjugate the canonical overlap identifications for M by the supplied component isomorphisms. Quasi-separatedness of Xj makes each overlap of the finite affine cover quasi-compact. Choose finite affine covers of all pairwise overlaps, intersections of their refinement charts, and triple overlaps. On these affine charts use the map clause of affine module descent to lift the conjugated comparisons and their specified inverses between the fixed models. Use the equality clause for inverse identities, agreement on refinement intersections, and triple cocycle equations. Directedness gives a common stage k for this finite list of maps and equations. For a preorder work on the partial-order quotient of the nonempty tail above j.

Glue comparison maps and inverses across the refinement charts. Their identities and the triple cocycle can be checked on the chosen finite covers. Pull the glued maps back to every test scheme mapping to two members of V; naturality, identity, and cocycle give the fields of the pseudofunctor descent datum D. Its local objects are the pullbacks of N, providing their asserted isomorphisms. Compose the given comparisons with pullback associativity to get the components of eta. The lifted transitions give its commutativity field, and its components are isomorphisms since they are composites of the given component isomorphisms and canonical pullback comparisons. Empty covers use the unique empty datum and morphism.
